name: Tracing how models compute step by step
gist: Instead of treating models as black boxes, these papers zoom into the circuits and wires inside—finding which parts perform specific tasks and how they talk to each other.
explain: A large language model processes text in layers. The first layer might extract simple patterns like 'this token is a noun.' A middle layer might combine patterns: 'this noun is the subject.' Deep layers might encode abstract reasoning. But how do these stages connect? Which earlier computations feed into which later ones? Can we find modular circuits — small groups of neurons that collaborate to solve one sub-problem? This line of research treats the model as an actual circuit: neurons are nodes, connections have weights, and information flows from input to output.

The difficulty is scale and entanglement. Even a small model has millions of connections. Most neurons participate in multiple tasks. A single neuron might fire for dozens of unrelated reasons. Researchers use techniques like activation patterns, attention weight analysis, and causal intervention — toggling parts of the model to see what breaks — to trace these circuits. The payoff is a mechanistic model: a picture of how the model actually computes, not just a statistical description. When you understand the circuit, you can predict failure modes and sometimes redesign it.

papers.title: All Circuits Lead to Rome: Rethinking Functional Anisotropy in Circuit and Sheaf Discovery for LLMs
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that mechanistic explanations in LLMs are inherently non-canonical with multiple, low-overlap circuit explanations, calling for rethinking how circuit discovery results should be interpreted.

papers.title: Certified Circuits: Stability Guarantees for Mechanistic Circuits
papers.contribution: Certified circuits achieve up to 56% higher accuracy and 80% fewer components while remaining reliable where baselines degrade, putting circuit discovery on formal ground.

papers.title: Circuit Insights: Towards Interpretability Beyond Activations
papers.contribution: Increases interpretability robustness by going beyond activation analysis to reveal circuit dynamics, enhancing scalable mechanistic analysis while maintaining efficiency.

papers.title: Decoupling Positional and Symbolic Attention in Transformers
papers.contribution: Shows strong correspondence between attention head behavior and frequency use; demonstrates that controlling which frequencies heads access directly controls Transformer performance.

papers.title: Expert Heads: Robust Evidence Identification for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Expert Heads significantly improve retrieval and ranking on multi-hop QA benchmarks, outperforming dense retrievers with minimal overhead and providing hallucination detection signals.

papers.title: From Directions to Regions: Decomposing Activations in Language Models via Local Geometry
papers.contribution: Outperforms unsupervised baselines and is competitive with supervised localization methods while achieving stronger steering performance than sparse autoencoders for concept discovery.

papers.title: Path Channels and Plan Extension Kernels: a Mechanistic Description of Planning in a Sokoban RNN
papers.contribution: The precise plan representation reveals how model-free RL implicitly learns a bidirectional planning algorithm in more familiar terms.

papers.title: SLASH the Sink: Sharpening Structural Attention Inside LLMs
papers.contribution: Delivers significant and consistent performance gains across diverse LLMs on graph tasks and molecular prediction with training-free solution requiring only attention redistribution.

papers.title: Scaling Reasoning Hop Exposes Weaknesses: Demystifying and Improving Hop Generalization in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: The lightweight intervention consistently improves reasoning hop generalization across tasks and LLMs by restoring correct predictions.

papers.title: Task Vectors, Learned Not Extracted: Performance Gains and Mechanistic Insights
papers.contribution: LTVs surpass extracted task vectors in accuracy and flexibility, revealing that TV propagation steers predictions through specific key attention heads and rotates early representations toward task-relevant subspaces.

papers.title: Transformers Don’t Need LayerNorm at Inference Time: Scaling LayerNorm Removal to GPT-2 XL and Implications for Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.contribution: Shows LayerNorm-free GPT-2 models can function with only +0.03 cross-entropy loss on GPT-2 XL, enabling more precise mechanistic interpretability research while clarifying LayerNorm's limited role in language modeling.

papers.title: A Distributional View for Visual Mechanistic Interpretability: KL-Minimal Soft-Constraint Principle
papers.contribution: Resolves biases under distributional view and demonstrates practical effectiveness on DINOv3 vision models.

papers.title: A Narrowing Geometry in Contaminated Reasoning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that narrowing geometry manifests as low-dimensional computation regime, and recovery approach achieves up to 11.03% absolute improvement in consistency.

papers.title: An Information-Theoretic Parameter-Free Bayesian Framework for Probing Labeled Dependency Trees from Attention Score
papers.contribution: Method probes complex dependency trees transparently with simpler models than previous approaches.

papers.title: Attention Sinks in Diffusion Transformers: A Causal Analysis
papers.contribution: Removing attention sinks does not degrade text-image alignment on Stable Diffusion 3, only under stronger interventions showing metric-dependent boundaries.

papers.title: Attributing Response to Context: A Jensen–Shannon Divergence Driven Mechanistic Study of Context Attribution in Retrieval-Augmented Generati
papers.contribution: Superior accuracy and computational efficiency on TyDi QA, Hotpot QA, and Musique while revealing specific attention heads and MLP layers responsible for context attribution.

papers.title: Decomposing Query-Key Feature Interactions Using Contrastive Covariances
papers.contribution: Identifies human-interpretable QK subspaces for categorical semantic features and binding features in large language models, enabling attribution of attention scores to identified features.

papers.title: Decomposing Representation Space into Interpretable Subspaces with Unsupervised Learning
papers.contribution: Subspaces show interpretability and connection to circuit variables, with evidence of scalability to 2B models and separation of context and knowledge routing.

papers.title: Deep neural networks divide and conquer dihedral multiplication
papers.contribution: Fully characterizes all learnable neural representations with clear three-level abstraction: neuron cosets, neural representations as Cayley graphs, and global linear combination.

papers.title: Do Language Models Track Entities Across State Changes?
papers.contribution: Reveals that LMs solve sequential tasks using non-sequential strategies and identifies fragile global suppression for REMOVE operations, suggesting mechanistic solutions.

papers.title: Does Reasoning Improve Seeing? Understanding When Vision-Language Models Benefit from Thinking
papers.contribution: Reasoning-tuned VLMs develop localized, manipulable circuits for meta-cognitive control; interventions improve accuracy by up to 5.3%.

papers.title: Dual Mechanisms of Value Expression: Intrinsic vs. Prompted Values in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Show that intrinsic and prompted mechanisms share common value components but also possess unique components; intrinsic promotes response diversity while prompted strengthens instruction compliance.

papers.title: Emergent Analogical Reasoning in Transformers
papers.contribution: Decomposes analogical reasoning into geometric alignment of relational structure and functor application, enabling mechanistic grounding of abstraction in neural networks.

papers.title: Faithful Bi-Directional Model Steering via Distribution Matching and Distributed Interchange Interventions
papers.contribution: CDAS enables bi-directional steering with more faithful and stable control, with steering factors derived from data reducing hyperparameter tuning effort.

papers.title: Formal Mechanistic Interpretability: Automated Circuit Discovery with Provable Guarantees
papers.contribution: Yields circuits with substantially stronger robustness guarantees than standard discovery methods, establishing principled foundation for provable circuit discovery.

papers.title: Function Induction and Task Generalization: An Interpretability Study with Off-by-One Addition
papers.contribution: Reveals function induction mechanism resembling induction heads at higher abstraction, shows it is reused across synthetic and algorithmic tasks, providing insights into task-level generalization.

papers.title: HaloProbe: Bayesian Detection and Mitigation of Object Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: HaloProbe-guided decoding reduces hallucinations more effectively than state-of-the-art intervention-based methods while preserving caption utility and linguistic fluency.

papers.title: How Do Transformers Learn to Associate Tokens: Gradient Leading Terms Bring Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.contribution: Theoretical weight characterizations closely match learned weights on real LLMs, revealing how each transformer component captures semantic associations based on corpus statistics.

papers.title: How Does Reasoning Flow? Tracing Attention-Induced Information Flow for Targeted RL in LLMs
papers.contribution: Delivers consistent performance gains on reasoning tasks by enabling learning signals to focus on tokens that route information toward correct answers.

papers.title: How Language Models Process Negation
papers.contribution: Shows that ablating late-layer attention modules greatly improves accuracy on negation questions, deepening understanding of LLM internals and highlighting construction-dominant computations and competing mechanisms.

papers.title: How Transformers Represent Hierarchies: A Local-to-Global Mechanism
papers.contribution: Reveals local-to-global parsing mechanism and construction achieving logarithmic depth matches trained Transformer behavior.

papers.title: Identifying and Evaluating Inactive Heads in Pretrained LLMs
papers.contribution: Shows over 12% of attention heads average inactive; can be ablated while maintaining accuracy, revealing attention sinks underestimate inactivity by 7%.

papers.title: In-Context Algebra
papers.contribution: Transformers consistently learn three mechanisms: commutative copying via dedicated heads, identity element recognition, and closure-based cancellation tracking group membership.

papers.title: Induction Heads Interpolate N-Grams
papers.contribution: Transformers learn to regularize in-context estimation via context-order interpolation and pseudo-count smoothing, matching or outperforming classical count-based baselines.

papers.title: Induction Meets Biology: Mechanisms of Repeat Detection in Protein Language Models
papers.contribution: Reveal that PLMs detect approximate repeats via a two-stage mechanism combining positional attention and biologically specialized components with induction-head cross-segment alignment.

papers.title: Interpreting Physics in Video World Models
papers.contribution: Identifies Physics Emergence Zone at intermediate depth where physical variables become linearly accessible; shows direction is encoded as circular high-dimensional population code requiring dozens of orthogonal dimensions.

papers.title: Interpreting and Steering State-Space Models via Activation Subspace Bottlenecks
papers.contribution: Across 7 SSMs and 6 benchmarks improves performance by average 8.27%, with Stable-Mamba achieving long-context gains when retrained from scratch.

papers.title: Language Models Use Lookbacks to Track Beliefs
papers.contribution: The analysis uncovers belief tracking via lookback mechanisms for character states, visibility relations, and belief updates, providing insights into Theory of Mind reasoning.

papers.title: Left–Right Symmetry Breaking in CLIP-Style Vision-Language Models Trained on Synthetic Spatial-Relation Data
papers.contribution: Contrastive training learns left-right relations driven primarily by label diversity; attention decomposition reveals that positional-token embedding interactions induce horizontal attention gradients that break symmetry.

papers.title: Localizing Task Recognition and Task Learning in In-Context Learning via Attention Head Analysis
papers.contribution: The framework demonstrates that TR heads align hidden states with task subspaces while TL heads perform rotations within the subspace, reconciling multiple prior findings about ICL mechanisms.

papers.title: MICLIP: Learning to Interpret Representation in Vision Models
papers.contribution: MICLIP enables precise causal-aware interpretation of both individual neurons and sparse autoencoder features, revealing semantic properties and enabling targeted manipulation of model behaviors.

papers.title: Map the Flow: Revealing Hidden Pathways of Information in VideoLLMs
papers.contribution: Analysis identifies that VideoLLMs retain performance by selecting effective information pathways while suppressing 58% of attention edges in LLaVA-NeXT-7B-Video-FT.

papers.title: Mechanisms of Introspective Awareness
papers.contribution: Establishes that introspection is behaviorally robust, grounded in nontrivial anomaly detection, and possesses greater capability than default elicitation reveals.

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability as Statistical Estimation: A Variance Analysis
papers.contribution: Demonstrate small perturbations yield vastly different circuits, emphasizing need for statistical robustness in mechanistic interpretability.

papers.title: Multimodal Function Vectors for Visual Relations
papers.contribution: Shows multimodal function vectors can be extracted to improve zero-shot accuracy at inference and fine-tuned with modest data to outperform in-context learning; demonstrates linear combination of relation-specific vectors solves analogy problems.

papers.title: Overthinking: Amplifying Reasoning Weights to Extract Learned Secrets
papers.contribution: Overthinking models reveal hidden information up to 10x more frequently than pure reasoning models across four settings with 2B-32B models.

papers.title: Patterning: The Dual of Interpretability
papers.contribution: Demonstrates re-weighting training data can accelerate/delay structure formation like induction circuits, and select which algorithm the model learns by targeting local learning coefficients.

papers.title: Probing Rotary Position Embeddings through Frequency Entropy
papers.contribution: Show that high-entropy dimensions are often redundant and can be attenuated at inference with negligible accuracy loss, providing design insights for RoPE.

papers.title: Protein Circuit Tracing via Cross-layer Transcoders
papers.contribution: Recovers 82-89% of original performance on classification/function prediction; identifies compressed circuits using <1% of latent space while retaining up to 79% accuracy.

papers.title: Provably Tracking Equivalent Mechanistic Interpretations Across Neural Networks
papers.contribution: We provide the first theoretical guarantees relating a model's algorithmic interpretations, circuits, and representations, laying foundations for more rigorous MI evaluation methods.

papers.title: Quantifying LLM Attention-Head Stability: Implications for Circuit Universality
papers.contribution: Establishes cross-instance robustness as prerequisite for scalable oversight; weight decay substantially improves stability; middle layers show strongest divergence.

papers.title: Reforming the Mechanism: Editing Reasoning Patterns in LLMs with Circuit Reshaping
papers.contribution: Demonstrates consistent improvements on propositional logic reasoning across three difficulty levels using Qwen-2.5-3B.

papers.title: Rethinking Layer Relevance in Large Language Models Beyond Cosine Similarity
papers.contribution: Analysis of LLMs shows need to move beyond cosine similarity for layer relevance assessment to enable better pruning strategies and lightweight models.

papers.title: SafeSeek: Universal Attribution of Safety Circuits in Language Models
papers.contribution: Identifies backdoor circuits (0.42% sparsity) that reduce attack success rate from 100% to 0.4%, and alignment circuits whose removal increases ASR from 0.8% to 96.9%.

papers.title: Shared Lexical Task Representations Explain Behavioral Variability In LLMs
papers.contribution: Shows behavioral variation can be explained by activation degree of lexical heads, with failures sometimes due to competing task representations diluting target signals.

papers.title: Shared Semantics, Divergent Mechanisms: Unsupervised Feature Discovery by Aligning Semantics and Mechanisms
papers.contribution: Discovers continuation modes missed by single-view baselines with interventional evidence that cluster signatures correspond to actionable mechanistic factors.

papers.title: Spurious Rewards Paradox: Mechanistically Understanding How RLVR Activates Memorization Shortcuts in LLMs
papers.contribution: Localizes the contamination mechanism and demonstrates bidirectional causal steering to amplify or suppress performance shortcuts.

papers.title: Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models
papers.contribution: Shows LLMs exhibit the same characteristic distance effect observed in humans on temporal order memory tasks, supporting temporal context reinstatement as a mechanism for episodic-like memory in both artificial and biological systems.

papers.title: The Cylindrical Representation Hypothesis for Language Model Steering
papers.contribution: Explains asymmetry in steering predictability; reveals that sensitive sectors cannot be inferred from difference vectors, providing an intrinsic source of uncertainty.

papers.title: The Mechanistic Emergence of Symbol Grounding in Language Models
papers.contribution: Grounding emerges through aggregate mechanisms in middle layers across Transformers and state-space models but not in LSTMs, with implications for controlling generation reliability.

papers.title: The Shape of Addition: Geometric Structures of Arithmetic in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Provides geometric framework explaining arithmetic failures and enables geometric consistency checks that detect and correct quantization errors during inference.

papers.title: The Truth Stays in the Family: Enhancing Contextual Truthfulness via Inherited Heads in Model Lineages
papers.contribution: Shows Truth Scores are strongly preserved within model families despite instruction tuning or multimodal adaptation; TruthProbe improves contextual truthfulness on HaluEval and reduces multimodal hallucination on POPE and CHAIR.

papers.title: Towards Understanding Subliminal Learning: When and How Hidden Biases Transfer
papers.contribution: Masking divergence tokens mostly removes hidden bias transfer, finetuning a single early layer suffices for subliminal learning, and subliminal learning is fragile to prompt paraphrasing.

papers.title: Towards Understanding the Nature of Attention with Low-Rank Sparse Decomposition
papers.contribution: Lorsa identifies a novel subtoken induction head type operating at character level, achieves parity with SAE in interpretability while exhibiting superior circuit-discovery properties.

papers.title: Translation Heads: Disentangling meaning from language in LLM-based machine translation
papers.contribution: Finds distinct sparse attention heads specialize in each subtask; modifying 1% of heads enables instruction-free performance comparable to instruction-based prompting.

papers.title: Translation Heads: Unveiling Attention's Role in LLM Multilingual Translation
papers.contribution: Token alignment heads are universal, sparse, consistent, causal for translation, and show specific functionality.

papers.title: Understanding Routing Mechanism in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
papers.contribution: Analysis reveals MoE entanglement patterns (consistent layer-to-layer firing correlation), persistent cross-layer influence of components, and different long/short-range promoting/inhibiting effects across models.

papers.title: Weight-sparse transformers have interpretable circuits
papers.contribution: Produces circuits with unprecedented human understandability, shows scaling improves capability-interpretability frontier.

papers.title: When Thinking Backfires: Mechanistic Insights into Reason-induced Misalignment
papers.contribution: Identifies reasoning-induced misalignment as activation entanglement between reasoning and safety, correlating with catastrophic forgetting.
